fusions.name: Scree Run
fusions.desc: Kicks loose a rockslide down a 5-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 14 rock damage to everything caught and knocking it 2.5 tiles back.

fusions.name: Tor Breaker
fusions.desc: Butts a target at or below 25% health for 24 rock damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drystone Rise
fusions.desc: Kicks up a ridge of stone 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Crag-Footed
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 8%, and your earth resistance rises by 10%.
